PNB is the market leader for unit trust business in Malaysia. PNB’s objective is to provide excellent unit trust services, innovative solutions for their customers and agents as well.
The first chapter of this document gives an introduction with brief background and organization of the document.  Subsequent chapters cover the details of the actual enhancements.

The enhancements scoped in the document are relating to multiple Teller reports consolidating into 1 and multiple Branch reports consolidating into single and remove the reports which are not required.
Currently a total of 23 reports need to be printed/downloaded by branch EOD for batching and reconciliation purpose.
Extraction logic of all the reports remains same.
